policies.title: Icelandic ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Iceland's current Foreign Ministry guidance says Icelandic travellers do not need a visa for Ukraine under a reciprocal agreement.
conditions: This is the reciprocal ordinary Icelandic-passport short-visit baseline; Ukraine's separate entry, territorial, security and final-admission rules remain applicable.
Work, residence, special travel documents and purpose-specific permits are outside this policy.
